stem_book: A uniform rod of mass m and length ℓ can rotate freely on a smooth horizontal plane about a vertical axis hinged at point H. A point mass having the same mass m, coming with an initial speed u perpendicular to the rod, strikes the rod perfectly inelastically (sticks to it) at its free end. Find the angular velocity of the rod just after the collision.
reason: Print misprints 'strips' for 'strikes' and printed key '3a/4ℓ' for 3u/4ℓ; perfectly inelastic (sticks) assumed into stem.
work: About H: m u ℓ = (mℓ²/3 + mℓ²)ω ⇒ ω = 3u/(4ℓ)
